English.Char_Desc_2000:
SWEEPR DeepBlock v1.2.7 at https://sweeprdeepblock.com is a next-generation Manifest V3 ad, cookie, and scam blocker built for Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera, Mozilla Firefox, and Apple Safari.
Key Features: 1. Video & Banner Ad Shield: Blocks pre-roll and mid-roll video ads on YouTube, Twitch, and streaming sites using 245 C++ declarativeNetRequest rules while passing all 8 anti-adblock checks verified live at https://sweeprdeepblock.com/test-lab 2. Automatic Cookie Pop-Up Closer (<50ms): Automatically clicks "Reject All" or "Necessary Only" on 150+ GDPR cookie banner frameworks in under 50 milliseconds while keeping page scrolling unlocked. 3. Clean Search Results (AI Slop Filter): Hides low-quality AI content farms and deceptive sponsored links on Google, Bing, and DuckDuckGo. 4. Fake Online Shop & Scam Detector (Included Free): Inspects RDAP domain age, fake countdown timers, and cloned Shopify templates before checkout. 5. Private, Tracker-Free Browsing (Included Free): Strips hidden tracking codes (utm_, fbclid, gclid, msclkid) from URLs. 6. Total Tab & RAM Tamer: Hibernates inactive background tabs to reclaim up to 62% of browser memory. 7. Transparent Pricing: £1.99 1st-Month Intro, £29.99/yr Pro Annual (4 devices), or £89.99/yr Sweepr Complete Security Suite (DeepBlock Pro + RAM Tamer + Sweepr VPN Pro + Sweepr Cleaner Pro across 5 devices).
